LESSON: PUPPETRY

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.4: Puppetry
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Puppetry, part of Performing and Displaying in Grade 5 CREATIVE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: how incorporating topical songs with proper voice projection and clarity in pronunciation of words (diction), Why are features of a puppet exaggerated?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify a glove puppet for familiarisation,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Puppetry in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. make a glove puppet using recyclable materials,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Puppetry in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. perform a puppet show while singing topical songs for enjoyment.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Puppetry in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

A. identify a glove puppet for familiarisation,

   Puppetry helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. make a glove puppet using recyclable materials,

C. perform a puppet show while singing topical songs for enjoyment.

1. Read this lesson on Puppetry together.
